proposed_widenings.name: composite_magic_item_mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: Rod of Alertness combines always-on held properties and a separate activated planted-aura property in the same item. Current MagicItemMechanics is a union of passive or activation, so one record cannot carry both honestly.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding the rod, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on Initiative rolls. ... As a Magic action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground ...

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.holding_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The rod's passive benefits and spell access are gated by holding the rod. Existing equipment predicates can express wearing armor or wielding a weapon, but not holding a magic item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding the rod, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on Initiative rolls. While holding the rod, you can cast the following spells from it

proposed_widenings.name: activated_item anchored/planted attachment with pull-to-end dismissal
proposed_widenings.justification: The protective aura is centered on the planted rod, persists for 10 minutes, and ends early when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground. Current activated-item phases do not encode a planted anchor with a manual dismiss action.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground ... The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground.

notes: Stopped before authoring content JSON/Dhall. The first honest blocker is structural: one magic item needs both passive held properties and a separate activated aura property. Additional secondary gaps also exist, including a missing holding-item predicate and likely a narrower area-scoped invisible-location sensing shape.
